'''Mudundi Ramakrishna Raju''' (1930 – 25 June 2025) was an Indian physicist, known for his research on the application of [[nuclear physics]] to [[cancer therapy]].<ref name="Bhimavaram Municipality">{{cite web | url=http://bhimavarammunicipality.com/mgmmt.aspx | title=Bhimavaram Municipality | publisher=Bhimavaram Municipality | date=2014 | access-date=18 December 2014 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141218105030/http://bhimavarammunicipality.com/mgmmt.aspx | archive-date=18 December 2014 | url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="Berkeley Science Review">{{cite web | url=http://berkeleysciencereview.com/from-particle-physics-to-radiation-oncology-to-public-health/ | title=Berkeley Science Review | publisher=Berkeley Science Review | date=2014 | access-date=18 December 2014}}</ref> He hailed from the Indian state of Andhra Pradesh<ref name="The Hindu">{{cite web | url=http://www.thehindu.com/todays-paper/rama-naidu-six-others-get-padma-awards/article4346703.ece | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130129172948/http://www.thehindu.com/todays-paper/rama-naidu-six-others-get-padma-awards/article4346703.ece | url-status=dead | archive-date=29 January 2013 | title=The Hindu | date=2013 | access-date=18 December 2014}}</ref> and was the Managing Trustee of the International Cancer Centre, Mahatma Gandhi Memorial Medical Trust located at [[Bhimavaram]].<ref name="Berkeley Science Review" /><ref name="AAPM">{{cite web | url=http://sandbox.aapm.org/international/reports/ayyangarpt2.asp | title=AAPM | publisher=AAPM | date=2014 | access-date=18 December 2014}}</ref> He was reported to have 35 years of research experience in [[radiation therapy]] at various institutions in the US such as [[Massachusetts General Hospital]], [[Harvard University]], [[Massachusetts Institute of Technology]], [[Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory]], [[University of California, Berkeley]] and [[Los Alamos National Laboratory]]<ref name="Bhimavaram Municipality" /><ref name="AAPM" /><ref name="Kshatriya">{{cite web | url=http://kshatriya.forumotion.com/t113-dr-m-r-raju | title=Kshatriya | publisher=Kshatriya | date=2014 | access-date=18 December 2014}}</ref> and is credited with several articles on the topic.<ref name="Berkeley Science Review" /><ref name="Sparrho">{{cite web | url=http://www.sparrho.com/article/UmF3QXJ0aWNsZQ==/1039567/?title=in-regard-to-zietman | title=Sparrho | publisher=Sparrho | date=2014 | access-date=18 December 2014}}</ref> Raju was honoured by the [[Government of India]], in 2013, with the fourth highest Indian civilian award of [[Padma Shri]].<ref name="Padma Shri">{{cite web | url=http://mha.nic.in/sites/upload_files/mha/files/LST-PDAWD-2013.pdf | title=Padma Shri | publisher=Padma Shri | date=2014 | access-date=11 November 2014}}</ref> Raju died on 25 June 2025, at the age of 95.<ref>[https://www.etvbharat.com/en/!bharat/andhra-pradesh-renowned-physicist-mr-raju-passes-away-at-95-made-pioneering-contributions-to-cancer-radiation-therapy-enn25062502731 Renowned Physicist Padma Shri MR Raju Passes Away At 95, Makes Pioneering Contributions to Cancer Radiation Therapy]</ref>
